messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: spike in hosted inference 5xxs and timeouts across eu-west-1 (avg 5xx rate 18%) — traces linked: https://alerts.internal/alert/1728001234
support-lisa: multiple customers escalated — some say API returns 502/504 during long-generation requests. I have a couple of request IDs if needed. :frowning:
oncall-jordan: I'm taking this. Can folks drop repros + recent deploys?
kevin: No deploys in last 3h to gateway. Seeing increased upstream 504s from inference-pool (k8s: inference-deployment-<hash>) and repeated client retries -> queued requests piling at gateway causing backpressure.
maria: Logs show KV-cache misses spike, and a lot of concurrent streams hitting same host. Also seeing 401s for a subset of tokens (expired refresh?). But majority are upstream 502/504.
ryan: Customers reporting timeouts on long streaming sessions (seq len ~ 2048). Some requests do finish but very slow.
oncall-jordan: Immediate mitigation suggestion? Toggle circuit breaker + reduce max concurrency per host?
kevin: Agreed. Plan: 1) enable gateway outbound circuit breaker to fail fast 502->client 2) temporarily reduce max_inflight to 8 for model-host pool 3) scale inference-pool by +30% 4) disable aggressive client retries (backoff to 2s, max 2).
infra-nikhil: I'll scale the inference pool now. kubectl scale deployment/inference-deployment --replicas=13 -n hosted-prod
kevin: Rolling config: gateway service param change ->
```
PATCH /v1/config/gateway
{ "outbound_circuit_breaker": { "max_requests": 10, "timeout_ms": 1500 } }
```
apply and watch.
maria: Pushed a temporary auth-token refresh check to filter 401s earlier in the proxy. This should reduce churn from token failures.
support-lisa: Noted - customers on enterprise plan were affected (ids: C-442, C-511). I'll send a status update after mitigation.
ops-bot: JOB: infra-nikhil scaled inference-deployment to 13 replicas, healthchecks green (pods 13/13)
kevin: Gateways patched with outbound_circuit_breaker. Starting canary rollout (20% of traffic). Monitoring traces.
oncall-jordan: Observability: p50 latency down 20% on canary, 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 6% in canary. Good sign.
ryan: Confirmed customer session C-442 retried and succeeded after canary (they reported a shorter time-to-first-token).
product-amy: Good. We'll hold until we see stable <2% 5xx across region before full rollout. Also want a postmortem capturing root cause and action items.
kevin: Full rollout initiated. Also put a temporary quota on streaming seq length >1500 to route long queries to dedicated capacity for now (to reduce pressure).
maria: Repro steps collected:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"large-sys","input":"<~2k tokens>"}' --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 60
2) Observe upstream gateway returning 504 with backtrace: "upstream idle timeout" in gateway logs
3) When running concurrent 20 streams targeting same host you'll hit queueing and then 502s
I'll attach logs to the incident board.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploys blocked until incident cleared for eu-west-1 hosted-api
support-lisa: Sending customer update: "We observed elevated 5xx/timeouts in eu-west-1 affecting longer generation requests. We applied routing mitigations and scaled capacity; returns to normal are in progress. Will follow up with root cause and timeline."
infra-nikhil: Full rollout complete. 5xx rate region-wide now ~1.8% and falling.
oncall-jordan: Marking this to transition to postmortem channel. Quick action items assigned:
- kevin: write detailed prox/gateway retry/circuit-breaker timeline + config diffs (due: +24h)
- maria: correlate KV-cache miss pattern with model/seq-length and submit fix for hotspotting (due: +48h)
- infra-nikhil: autoscaler tuning for inference pool (min/scale-window) and a runbook change to pre-scale on seq-length surge signals (due: +72h)
- support-lisa: customer communication follow-ups + credits where applicable (due: +24h)
- ryan: create synthetic test for long streaming sessions in eu-west to catch regressions (due: +48h)
product-amy: Also add a roadmap ticket to evaluate routing long requests to dedicated capacity automatically (owner: product-amy, due: next sprint).
kevin: Root cause hypothesis: combined effect of token-refresh churn + large-seq concurrent streams causing request funneling to a subset of inference hosts -> upstream queue buildup -> idle timeouts -> client retries that amplified load. We'll validate with traces.
oncall-jordan: Thanks all. Postmortem doc in #postmortems + link to action items. Reopen if regression. :thumbsup:
